workarounds.note: renderPageToCanvas paints with the direction the canvas inherits (ctx.direction 'inherit'), and the cjk kit's showBook sets dir="rtl" on each spread of a right-bound book, so every upright character of a vertical line is anchored from its right and the lines overlap in the live viewer (the capture paints outside the spread and is not affected). The pen sets #pages canvas { direction: ltr }, as Nº 075 does; the fix belongs in renderPageToCanvas (ctx.direction = 'ltr') or in showBook's style.
